definitions.explanation: Studying, especially as a student's main occupation. A formal, written word.

examples.japanese: {勉学|べんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧。
⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{勉学|べんがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I studied abroad and continued my studies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{奨学金|しょうがくきん}→奨学金：03230_shougakukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧な⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勉学|べんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the scholarship, I could concentrate on my studies without worrying about money.

notes:
Formal: used in speeches, school documents and letters. In conversation, ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧ is the normal word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勉学|べんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧: to work hard at one's studies
- {勉学|べんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{専念|せんねん}する→専念する：25369_sennensuru⟧: to devote oneself to study
- {勉学|べんがく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部活動|ぶかつどう}→部活動：14539_bukatsudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両立|りょうりつ}→両立：11310_ryouritsu⟧: balancing study and club activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧: study — the everyday word
- ⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧: learning, scholarship — the body of knowledge itself
